an5.38:1.3: ye te bhikkhave loke santo sappurisā te saddhaññeva paṭhamaṃ anukampantā anukampanti no tathā assaddhaṃ
an5.38:1.4: saddhaññeva paṭhamaṃ upasaṅkamantā upasaṅkamanti no tathā assaddhaṃ
an5.38:1.5: saddhasseva paṭhamaṃ paṭiggaṇhantā paṭiggaṇhanti no tathā assaddhassa
an5.38:1.6: saddhasseva paṭhamaṃ dhammaṃ desentā desenti no tathā assaddhassa
an5.38:1.7: saddho kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ upapajjati
an5.38:1.8: ime kho bhikkhave pañca saddhe kulaputte ānisaṃsā
an5.38:2.1: seyyathāpi bhikkhave subhūmiyaṃ catummahāpathe mahānigrodho samantā pakkhīnaṃ paṭissaraṇaṃ hoti
an5.38:2.2: evameva kho bhikkhave saddho kulaputto bahuno janassa paṭissaraṇaṃ hoti bhikkhūnaṃ bhikkhunīnaṃ upāsakānaṃ upāsikānanti.
